title: mxv/list/v1
description: One page of the workspaces, in name order, and the number of workspaces.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

code.description: The over-budget code, in the tool's spelling.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

backend.description: The version-control system that made the checkout, which is `git`.

base.description:
The remote branch that the branch started from, such as
`refs/remotes/origin/main`.

branch.description: The branch that the checkout was created on.

commit.description:
The commit that the branch started at, or null in a dry run, which
does not fetch.

name.description: The repository's name, which names the checkout's directory.

branch.description: The branch that the workspace's checkouts were created on.

checkouts.description: The workspace's checkouts, one for each repository.

name.description:
The workspace's name, which is also the name of its directory and of
its checkouts' branch.

path.description: The workspace's directory, which `mxv cd` prints.

problem.description:
Why mxv cannot read the workspace's record, such as a record that
is not JSON or that a newer mxv wrote, or empty when it can. A row
with a problem names its record, without `.json`, in `name`, and
leaves the other fields empty.

repositories.description:
The top-level directory of each repository that the workspace checks
out.
